information: This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/), [Speedcubeshop](https://speedcubeshop.com/), and QiYi Toys. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) ![](https://s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/www.worldcubeassociation.org/t1mw6ezsl1ottvoqatdwqyeagoay?response-content-disposition=inline%3B%20filename%3D%22Qiyi_logos_all.png%22%3B%20filename%2A%3DUTF-8%27%27Qiyi_logos_all.png&response-content-type=image%2Fpng&X-Amz-Algorithm=AWS4-HMAC-SHA256&X-Amz-Credential=AKIAJO3UXGQGPMNLN5IQ%2F20250711%2Fus-west-2%2Fs3%2Faws4_request&X-Amz-Date=20250711T041547Z&X-Amz-Expires=300&X-Amz-SignedHeaders=host&X-Amz-Signature=fcd783d2c31a8b7600effac1958304b295b36be6dfa8e15dc8e80ba220d5f0c6) ### Get ready for the second annual Davis Summer competition! All attendees under the age of 18 are required to be accompanied by a parent or guardian. **Competition Day Timing** - The competition will begin at the scheduled start time. - Lunch will end at the scheduled time. - Events will begin as soon as the previous event is wrapping up. Exception: All First Round events will not start more than 20 minutes early. - Competitors may not compete in an event if they miss last call for that event. In general, last call is a few minutes after the last group is called.
